headline: Our friendship was a valid token, but after that argument it became a REVOKED TOKEN—no more doors open for me.
caption:
Our friendship was a valid token, but after that argument it became a REVOKED TOKEN—no more doors open for me.

—
REVOKED TOKEN: access that was granted and then withdrawn, so it no longer opens anything.
